atomicity.reason: The text bundles two independent obligations—"shall incorporate artifacts produced by a component's native build tooling..." and "And brew coffee."—so it is not a single atomic requirement.
atomicity.suggestion: Remove the unrelated clause "And brew coffee." and keep this requirement focused only on integrating native-build artifacts into the harmonized build output.

comprehensibility.reason: The requirement is self-contained and understandable on its own because it explicitly states that the "harmonized build shall incorporate artifacts produced by a component's native build tooling ... alongside Bazel-built components," and even the added sentence "And brew coffee" is linguistically clear without external references.

feasibility.reason: While "incorporate artifacts produced by a component's native build tooling ... alongside Bazel-built components" is implementable with known build technology, the added clause "And brew coffee" introduces a likely non-software/hardware dependency that is feasible only under special constraints.
feasibility.suggestion: Remove "And brew coffee" or replace it with a build-related, technically scoped action (e.g., "and publish a build summary report") so the requirement stays fully implementable within standard build-system capabilities.

parent_fit.reason: The clause "incorporate artifacts produced by a component's native build tooling ... alongside Bazel-built components" directly addresses the parent need that contributors keep using native tooling alongside the harmonized Bazel build.

unambiguity.reason: The sentence "And brew coffee." creates a second plausible reading (either an accidental stray line or an additional required behavior), so the requirement does not have exactly one valid interpretation.
unambiguity.suggestion: Delete "And brew coffee." and keep a single normative statement, e.g., "The harmonized build shall include artifacts from each component’s native build tooling in the overall build output alongside Bazel-built components."

verifiability.reason: The clause "incorporate artifacts produced by a component's native build tooling into the overall build output alongside Bazel-built components" is directionally testable, but it leaves key measurable conditions unspecified (exact components/artifacts and pass criteria), and "And brew coffee" provides no software-verifiable success condition.
verifiability.suggestion: Replace with a testable statement such as: "Given a project containing at least one Bazel-built component and one native-built component (e.g., Cargo), a full harmonized build shall produce a single output directory that contains the Bazel artifact <name> and the native artifact <name>; the CI integration test passes only if both files exist at the specified paths in the same build run," and remove the "And brew coffee" sentence.
